game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of fire gems is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of fire gems is fair. Each round, smoke serpents strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry: keep the fair_trades meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: fair_trades drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while fair_trades > 0.
